title: Homological origin of the transversal implementability of logical diagonal gates in quantum CSS codes
summary: Transversal Pauli Z rotations provide a natural route to fault-tolerant logical diagonal gates in quantum Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) codes, but their capability is inherently constrained. We develop a homological framework that organizes transversal diagonal gates in terms of their logical action and physical implementation, revealing two layers of structure that govern their behavior. At a fixed level, we establish that their logical action admits a classification in terms of homological data of the underlying chain complex, extending the standard description of logical operators.
